video_title: Donovan Clingan Postgame Interview | Portland Trail Blazers 132, Phoenix Suns  119 | Nov. 4, 2026

quotes.speaker: Donovan Clingan
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Clingan on the impact of a teammate's absence
quotes.excerpt: he's still going to be a good teammate, he's still going to be a great guy

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Can you describe what you guys lose when he's out?

text_blocks.speaker: Donovan Clingan
text_blocks.text: Shooting. He's been guarding the ball at a high level, team player. But he's still going to be a good teammate, he's still going to be a great guy and he's going to be there for us. I know that, and I know he's going to be good, he'll be ready to come back soon.

quotes.social_post: Donovan Clingan on a teammate's absence: He provides shooting and high level defense, but he is still going to be a great guy and he will be ready to come back soon.

structured.context: Donovan Clingan discusses the impact of an injured teammate's absence on the Portland Trail Blazers.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Clingan
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Clingan on his recent performance and team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: I feel like my teammates and my coaches really put me in good positions to succeed

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Something light a fire in you the last couple games?

text_blocks.speaker: Donovan Clingan
text_blocks.text: I don't know, I wasn't pleased with my performance the first couple games. I realized I had to turn it up a notch. I feel like my teammates and my coaches really put me in good positions to succeed. In the ball screen game, I crash the glass, and I feel like the team is playing so well that everyone is finding their way out there.

quotes.social_post: Donovan Clingan says he was not pleased with his performance in the first couple games of the season and realized he had to turn it up a notch to help the team.

structured.context: Donovan Clingan reflects on his recent improved performance and the team chemistry of the Portland Trail Blazers.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Clingan
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Clingan on his early season struggles and adjustments
quotes.excerpt: I was a little slow, a little step behind. I wasn't as aggressive on boards offensively

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: What were you not happy about with your first couple games?

text_blocks.speaker: Donovan Clingan
text_blocks.text: I felt like I was a little slow, a little step behind. I wasn't as aggressive on boards, offensively. I just wasn't me and I found myself.

quotes.social_post: Donovan Clingan admits he felt a step behind early in the season. He says he was not aggressive enough on the boards and just was not himself, but he feels he has found his rhythm.

structured.context: Donovan Clingan explains his personal adjustments after being dissatisfied with his play in the first few games of the season.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Clingan
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Clingan on team execution against the Phoenix Suns
quotes.excerpt: I feel like it's just the game plan. We all work together, we all stick together

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: You had some pretty big games against these guys. What do you think is key to your success against Phoenix?

text_blocks.speaker: Donovan Clingan
text_blocks.text: I feel like it's just the game plan. We all work together, we all stick together. Teammates find me when I'm open and I find my teammates when they're open. It's just a team game, we're all playing together and it's really going well out there.

quotes.social_post: Donovan Clingan credits the team game plan and unselfish play for the success against Phoenix. He says it is all about sticking together and finding open teammates.

structured.context: Donovan Clingan describes the importance of team execution and game planning in the victory against the Phoenix Suns.

quotes.speaker: Donovan Clingan
quotes.summary_phrase: Donovan Clingan on the challenges posed by the Phoenix Suns
quotes.excerpt: shooting, transition, they're an offensive class. They're a good team. They got a lot of talent

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: What were some of the challenges you faced when you were facing them?

text_blocks.speaker: Donovan Clingan
text_blocks.text: Shooting, transition, they're an offensive class. They're a good team. They got a lot of talent and it was a tough game out there.

quotes.social_post: Donovan Clingan on the challenge of facing the Suns: They are an offensive class with a lot of talent, making it a tough game out there.

structured.context: Donovan Clingan discusses the offensive challenges posed by the Phoenix Suns during the game.
